name: Prefect (Self-Hosted)
description: Deploy Prefect, the open-source workflow orchestration server for Python data pipelines. Runs the official image on ECS Fargate as a web tier and a background-services task, with RDS PostgreSQL and ElastiCache Redis, behind a password-protected load balancer (~$117/mo).

cpu.title: Task CPU
cpu.description: Fargate CPU units for each Prefect task — the web tier and the background services (256 = 0.25 vCPU).

memoryMiB.title: Task Memory (MiB)
memoryMiB.description: Fargate memory for each Prefect task. Must suit the CPU: 256 → 512–2048, 512 → 1024–4096, 1024 → 2048–4096, 2048 → 4096.

desiredCount.title: Web Tasks
desiredCount.description: Number of Prefect web (API + UI) tasks behind the load balancer. The background services always run as one task.

dbMultiAz.title: RDS Multi-AZ
dbMultiAz.description: Keep a standby database in a second availability zone. Doubles the database cost.

domainName.title: Custom Domain
domainName.description: Optional custom domain (e.g., prefect.example.com). Served over HTTPS with an ACM certificate.

hostedZoneId.title: Route 53 Hosted Zone ID
hostedZoneId.description: Hosted zone for the certificate validation and DNS records.

destroyDataOnDelete.title: Delete Data With the Stack
destroyDataOnDelete.description: Delete the database when the stack is deleted instead of keeping a final snapshot. Leave off unless the flow run history is disposable.

estimatedCost.description: ~$117/mo: 2 Fargate tasks (web + background services) ~$36, NAT gateway ~$33, load balancer ~$20, RDS db.t4g.micro ~$14, ElastiCache cache.t4g.micro ~$12, Secrets Manager + logs ~$2
